'''Tashtor Seneca''' was a location<ref name="GG9">''[[Galaxy Guide 9: Fragments from the Rim]]''</ref> in the [[Tashtor Seneca system/Legends|Tashtor Seneca system]], a part of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim's]] [[Tashtor sector/Legends|Tashtor sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Imperial Military/Legends|forces]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] destroyed the ''[[Croc of Gold]]'', the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[operative]] [[Devon Fuller]], over Tashtor Seneca.<ref name="GG9" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tashtor Seneca was mentioned in ''[[Galaxy Guide 9: Fragments from the Rim]]'', a [[1993]] sourcebook written by [[Simon Smith]] and [[Eric S. Trautmann]] for [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="GG9" />
